name: ClawForge
description: Intent-aware context engine — classifies each turn's intent and loads only relevant context sources. Saves 40-50% on input tokens with no quality regression.

classifyModel.description: Intent classifier: 'local' (TF-IDF, no API) or 'openai' (GPT-4o-mini, higher accuracy)

intentThreshold.description: Minimum confidence to load intent-specific context. Below this, loads default set

demoteThreshold.description: Context window usage % that triggers pre-response demotion

statsPath.description: Local SQLite path for per-turn stats

observecoEndpoint.description: ObserveCo server URL for stats reporting

logSkippedSources.description: Log every skipped source (verbose, for debugging)
